I'd rather work in an office. First, I can talk with my coworkers face to face, so problems get solved quickly. Second, I focus better at the office because there are fewer distractions than at home.

answers: Last month, we faced a challenge with a tight deadline. I solved it by dividing the tasks clearly.

Last month, my team faced a challenge with a very tight deadline for a client project. I solved it by dividing the tasks clearly and checking our progress every morning. Because of that, we finished the project on time, and the client was satisfied.

answers: We usually communicate through a team chat, and we have a short meeting every Monday morning.

We usually communicate through a team chat app because it is fast and easy. We also have a short meeting every Monday morning to share our weekly plans. When something is urgent, I just call my teammates directly.

I use my smartphone most often. It is like a small computer in my pocket. I can check my work emails, find directions with maps, and pay for things easily. Because of that, I save a lot of time every day.

Yes, I think people spend too much time on their phones. For example, many people check social media even while they are eating dinner with their family. As a result, they talk with each other less, and their relationships can suffer.

Technology has changed the way I work a lot. In the past, I had to be in the office for every meeting. Now I can join video meetings from anywhere and share files online in seconds. This makes my work faster and more flexible.

items.promptEn: Would you buy a product online without reading reviews?

No, I wouldn't. I always read reviews before I buy anything online. Reviews show the real quality of a product, and they help me avoid bad purchases. For example, I once almost bought a cheap jacket, but the reviews said it tore easily.

items.explanationKo: No, I wouldn't.로 짧게 답한 뒤 이유를 붙여요.

answers: I try not to buy things I don't really need.

items.promptEn: Where do you usually buy clothes, and why?
answers: I usually buy clothes online because there are more choices and I can easily compare prices.

I usually buy clothes online. There are many more choices than in local stores, and I can easily compare prices on different websites. Also, free returns make it easy to send things back if they don't fit.
items.meaningKo: 옷을 보통 어디서 사고, 왜인가요?
items.explanationKo: 장소 → 이유 두 가지(choices, prices) 순서로 말해요.

items.promptEn: When was the last time you bought something expensive?
answers: Last month, I bought a new laptop. It was expensive, but I need it for work every day.

The last time I bought something expensive was last month. I bought a new laptop because my old one was too slow for my work. It was expensive, but I use it every day, so I think it was worth the money.
items.meaningKo: 마지막으로 비싼 물건을 산 게 언제인가요?
items.explanationKo: 언제 → 무엇을 → 왜 샀는지를 과거 시제로 말해요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 40초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Do you think advertisements influence what people buy?
answers: Yes, I think ads influence people a lot, especially on social media, because they appear everywhere.

Yes, I think advertisements strongly influence what people buy. These days, ads appear everywhere, especially on social media and video sites. They show products again and again, so people start to feel they need them. I have bought things because of ads too.
items.meaningKo: 광고가 사람들의 구매에 영향을 준다고 생각하나요?
items.explanationKo: especially로 구체적인 예를 덧붙이면 좋아요.

items.promptEn: What is more important to you when shopping, price or quality?
answers: Quality is more important to me than price. Cheap products often break quickly, so I end up paying more.

For me, quality is more important than price. Cheap products often break quickly, so I end up buying the same thing twice and paying more. For example, I bought cheap shoes last year, and they lasted only two months.
items.meaningKo: 쇼핑할 때 가격과 품질 중 무엇이 더 중요한가요?
items.explanationKo: A is more important than B로 선택을 분명히 해요.

answers: I strongly believe that reading every day makes people smarter.
I strongly believe reading every day makes people smarter.

items.explanationKo: 동명사 주어(reading)는 단수 동사(makes)를 써요.

I strong believe that reading every day makes people smarter.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Do you agree that it is better to live in a city than in the countryside?
answers: I agree. Living in a city is more convenient because jobs, hospitals, and transportation are nearby.

I agree that it is better to live in a city. First, cities have more job opportunities, so young people can build their careers. Second, hospitals and public transportation are much better, which makes daily life convenient. Of course, the countryside is quieter, but for me, convenience matters more.
items.meaningKo: 시골보다 도시에 사는 게 낫다는 데 동의하나요?
items.explanationKo: 입장 → First, Second → 반대 측면 인정(Of course) 순서로 말해요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Some people say that working from home is more productive. What do you think?
answers: I think it depends on the person. Some people focus better at home, but others need an office.

I think it depends on the person. Some people focus better at home because there are no interruptions from coworkers. However, others need the structure of an office to stay motivated. In my case, I work best with a mix of both, two days at home and three in the office.
items.meaningKo: 재택근무가 더 생산적이라는 의견을 어떻게 생각하나요?
items.explanationKo: It depends로 시작해 두 경우와 내 경우를 차례로 말해요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: What is one skill that every young person should learn? Explain why.
answers: Every young person should learn how to manage money, because it helps them avoid debt and plan their future.

I think every young person should learn how to manage money. Many young people start using credit cards without understanding interest, so they quickly fall into debt. If they learn to make a budget and save regularly, they can avoid debt and plan their future with confidence.
items.meaningKo: 모든 젊은이가 배워야 할 기술 하나와 그 이유는?
items.explanationKo: 기술 하나를 정하고 because로 이유, If로 효과를 말해요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Is it better to have a few close friends or many casual friends?
answers: I prefer a few close friends because I can trust them and talk about anything.

I prefer to have a few close friends. With close friends, I can trust them completely and talk about anything, even serious problems. Having many casual friends can be fun, but those relationships are often shallow. In difficult times, a few true friends are much more helpful.
items.meaningKo: 소수의 친한 친구와 다수의 가벼운 친구 중 무엇이 나은가요?
items.explanationKo: 선택 → 이유 → 다른 쪽의 한계 순서로 비교해요.

items.explanationKo: 효율적인 건 efficient, 효과적인 건 effective예요.

items.explanationKo: solution is to 동사로 해결책을 말해요.
distractors: One possible solution is hire more staff.
One possible solution is to hire more staffs.

If we leave earlier, we can avoid the traffic.

answers: The main problem is that we don't have enough time.

items.explanationKo: The main problem is that ~으로 핵심 문제를 짚어요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Your team keeps missing deadlines. What would you suggest?
answers: I would suggest weekly check-in meetings and a shared task list, so we never miss a deadline.

I would suggest two things. First, we should hold short weekly check-in meetings so that everyone can share their progress. Second, we should use a shared task list with clear deadlines. That way, we can find problems early and fix them before the deadline.
items.meaningKo: 팀이 계속 마감을 놓쳐요. 무엇을 제안하겠어요?
items.explanationKo: I would suggest 뒤에 해결책 두 가지를 First, Second로 말해요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Many employees feel stressed at work. How can companies help them?
answers: Companies can help by offering flexible hours and short breaks. Managers should also check in with employees regularly.

Companies can help in several ways. First, they can offer flexible working hours, so employees can balance work and family. Second, they should encourage short breaks during the day. Finally, managers should check in with employees regularly and listen to their concerns before stress becomes serious.
items.meaningKo: 직원들이 스트레스를 받아요. 회사는 어떻게 도울 수 있을까요?
items.explanationKo: can help by -ing로 방법을 말하고 should로 제안을 더해요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Traffic in big cities is getting worse. What can be done about it?
answers: Cities should improve public transportation and encourage carpooling. Then fewer people will drive alone, and traffic will improve.

I think there are two main solutions. First, cities should improve public transportation by adding more buses and subway lines. If public transportation is fast and cheap, more people will leave their cars at home. Second, companies can encourage carpooling and flexible hours, so fewer people drive at the same time.
items.meaningKo: 대도시 교통 체증이 심해져요. 어떻게 해결할 수 있을까요?
items.explanationKo: 해결책 → 기대 효과(Then ~ will) 순서로 말해요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: A coworker often interrupts you during meetings. How would you handle it?
answers: I would talk to the coworker privately and politely explain how the interruptions affect my work.

I would handle it calmly. First, I would talk to my coworker privately after the meeting, not in front of others. I would politely explain that the interruptions make it hard for me to finish my points. Most people do not realize they interrupt, so a friendly talk usually solves the problem.
items.meaningKo: 동료가 회의 중에 자주 말을 끊어요. 어떻게 대처하겠어요?
items.explanationKo: 가정 질문에는 I would + 동사로 답해요.

answers: argument
reason

items.explanationKo: argument는 ‘말다툼’ 말고 ‘논거’라는 뜻도 있어요.

answers: persuade
convince
items.meaningKo: 설득하다
items.explanationKo: persuade A to 동사는 ‘A가 ~하도록 설득하다’예요.

answers: I partly agree, but I have some concerns.

I partially agree, but I have a few concerns.

items.explanationKo: agree는 동사라 I am agree라고 하지 않아요.
distractors: I am partly agree, but I have some concerns.
I partly agree, but I have some concern.

answers: Although it costs more, it is better for the environment.
Even though it costs more, it's better for the environment.
It costs more, but it's better for the environment.

distractors: Although it costs more, but it is better for the environment.
Although it cost more, it is better for environment.

answers: That's a valid point, but I see it differently.
items.meaningKo: 타당한 지적이지만, 저는 다르게 봐요.
items.explanationKo: valid point는 ‘타당한 지적’이에요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Do you agree or disagree that students should wear school uniforms?
answers: I agree, because uniforms reduce pressure about clothes and help students focus on studying.

I agree that students should wear school uniforms. First, uniforms reduce peer pressure about expensive clothes, so students from different backgrounds feel equal. Second, students do not waste time choosing outfits in the morning, so they can focus more on studying. For these reasons, I support school uniforms.
items.meaningKo: 학생들이 교복을 입어야 한다는 의견에 동의하나요?
items.explanationKo: 입장을 먼저 밝히고 because로 이유를 대요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Do you agree or disagree that companies should let employees choose their own working hours?
answers: I agree, because flexible hours let employees work when they focus best and improve work-life balance.

I agree with this idea. First, people have different routines, so flexible hours let employees work when they focus best. For example, some people are more productive early in the morning. Second, flexible hours improve work-life balance, which makes employees happier and more loyal to the company.
items.meaningKo: 직원이 근무 시간을 직접 정하게 해야 한다는 의견에 동의하나요?
items.explanationKo: 이유마다 For example로 근거를 붙이면 설득력이 커져요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Some people save money for the future, while others prefer to enjoy it now. Which do you prefer?
answers: I prefer to save money, because unexpected problems can happen, and savings give me peace of mind.

I prefer to save money rather than spend it all now. Unexpected problems, like losing a job or getting sick, can happen anytime. When I have savings, I feel peace of mind. Of course, I still enjoy small pleasures, like a nice dinner once a month, but saving comes first.
items.meaningKo: 미래를 위해 저축하는 것과 지금 즐기는 것 중 무엇이 좋은가요?
items.explanationKo: prefer to A rather than B로 선택을 분명히 해요.

items.promptKo: 토익 스피킹 질문이에요. 45초 동안 답해 보세요.
items.promptEn: Do you agree or disagree that technology has made people less social?
answers: I disagree. Technology helps people stay connected, like video calls with family who live far away.

I disagree with this statement. Technology actually helps people stay connected. For example, I have video calls with my family who live far away, and I join online groups with people who share my hobbies. Of course, some people use their phones too much, but overall technology brings people together.
items.meaningKo: 기술 때문에 사람들이 덜 사교적이 됐다는 의견에 동의하나요?
items.explanationKo: 반대 입장도 I disagree로 분명히 밝히고 예를 들어요.
